newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil home appliances maintained.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil home appliances maintained.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it was maintaining its neutral rating on Brazilian home appliance firms Refripar and Brasmotor in the intermediate term.

-- "We think industry fundamentals peaked in October and will most likely experience a period of accommodation during the next few months, resulting in flat earnings in 1997," the brokerage said in a report.

-- It said December's sales should be 16.6 percent lower than November's if the decline in sales is similar to that of last year. It also said 1996 appliance sales should increase 26.8 percent over 1995, lower than the 29.1 percent registered in 1995.
-- Refripar preferred traded at 2.21 reais, off 9.4 percent, while Brasmotor preferred fell 0.3 percent to 294 reais this morning on the Sao Paulo bourse.
